title: TICOM and ALSOS technology retrieval

tellings.quote: Nazis had all this advanced technology and you had TACOM and ASOS.

plain: Near the end of the Second World War, the Nazis are said to have held a great deal of advanced technology, and the Allies ran two programmes, TICOM and ALSOS, that went into Europe in 1944 and 1945 to recover it. Michels brings this up himself in a conversation with a former presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren, and names no source. He mentions it only in passing, as the backdrop to how wartime secrets ended up in American hands.
